items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Billy May brought an arrangement in back in 1939 or '40... I said, 'I haven't got a soprano, Billy.' And he said, 'Well, go buy one, the part's here.' And I did.

ctx.x: See, I never owned a soprano until Billy May brought an arrangement in back in 1939 or '40, with
a soprano part, and I said, "I haven't got a soprano, Billy." And he said, "Well, go buy one, the part's here." And I did.
